intents.tour: Happy to! I'll walk you through the website — services, products, how we work, and how to reach the team. You can skip or ask questions at any step.
intents.benefits: The main benefits of working with SCS Softwares: you see an estimated team, cost and timeline before committing; pricing is transparent and hourly; you own the full source code from day one; and you get weekly clickable demos with a dedicated project manager.
intents.pros-cons: Fair question. Pros: transparent estimates, full code ownership, one team for design-to-deploy, weekly demos. Cons to be aware of: custom builds take longer than ready-made products, third-party costs (hosting, gateways) are separate, and final quotes need a scoping call. For your specific project I can generate a pros/cons list with the requirement flow.
intents.products: SCS offers ready-made, customizable products across web, mobile, cloud, marketing and DevOps — proven bases you can launch quickly instead of building from zero. Want to browse them or tell me what you need so I can point you to a fit?
intents.need-website: Great — websites are our core service. To recommend the right team and give you a preliminary demo estimate, I'll ask a few quick questions about what you want to build.
intents.choose-service: That depends on where you are: a brand-new idea usually starts with UI/UX design plus web or mobile development, while an existing app that misbehaves starts with a rescue audit. Which describes you better?
intents.how-long: Duration depends on scope. As a demo reference: a typical web app estimate lands around 50–70 hours, and with a 40-hour weekly team capacity that is roughly 2 weeks of build plus a launch week. Answer the requirement questions and I will calculate a duration for your exact project.
intents.application-process: Applying is simple: check the open positions on the careers page, then submit the application form with your details and portfolio. The team reviews applications and contacts shortlisted candidates for an interview.
intents.whatsapp: You can chat with the SCS team on WhatsApp — I will open it with a short intro message you can review and send yourself.
intents.about-buddy: I'm Buddy, an AI agent built by SCS Softwares. I can speak with you, answer questions about the company, collect what your project needs and prepare a preliminary estimate. The same kind of agent is something we build for other companies — as a voice agent inside a site or app, or as a chat assistant grounded in your own content.

faq.cost: We work on transparent hourly pricing at a standard rate of up to $5 per hour, with a maximum of 40 development hours per week — that is up to $200 for a full delivery week, and roughly $800–$1,000 for a full-time month. Tell me your budget and I will build the strongest production-ready scope inside it, and show exactly what falls outside it.

assistant.fallback: I'm a demo assistant, so I may not have understood that. Here are things I can help with:

intents.fix-existing: We help rescue and finish existing projects — React, Node, PHP, WordPress, mobile apps and more. I can run a quick demo analysis of your project to estimate the team, hours and cost needed to fix it.
intents.build-new: Great — SCS Softwares builds web and mobile products end to end. Tell me about your idea through a short guided flow and you will get a demo estimate of team, hours, cost and timeline.
intents.cost: We work on transparent hourly pricing at a standard rate of up to $5 per hour, with a maximum of 40 development hours per week — up to $200 for a full delivery week and roughly $800–$1,000 for a full-time month. Tell me your budget and the estimator builds the strongest production-ready scope inside it, listing exactly what falls outside it.
intents.which-developer: That depends on your project scope. Our demo analysis recommends an exact team — for a typical web app that is a requirement analyst, UI/UX designer, frontend and backend developers plus a QA tester, with hours per role.
intents.services: SCS Softwares offers web development, mobile app development, UI/UX design, cloud solutions, DevOps and digital marketing. You can browse each service or jump straight to a project estimate.
intents.schedule: You can pick a date and time slot that suits you — the scheduling page shows available demo slots (calendar integration comes later).
intents.human: Of course — you can reach the SCS Softwares team directly through the contact page, or book a call at a time that works for you.
intents.estimate-explain: The estimate works from your requirements: each one is classified as essential, important or optional, hours come from a fixed effort table, and the total is those hours at up to $5 per hour. Your budget then decides which requirements fit — the rest are listed as deferred, never hidden. Duration divides total hours by a maximum 40-hour delivery week. It is preliminary: a human technical review confirms the final scope and quote.
intents.careers: We are always looking for talented people! Check our current openings on the careers page.

help.title: Microphone blocked? How to allow it
help.intro: We cannot change your browser permissions — only you can. These steps stay on your device:
help.general1: Click the lock or settings icon beside the address bar.
help.general4: Reload the page, or run the test again.
help.chrome: Click the icon at the left of the address bar → Site settings → Microphone → Allow, then reload the page.
help.safari: macOS: Safari menu → Settings for This Website → Microphone → Allow. iPhone or iPad: Settings → Safari → Microphone, or the “aA” menu → Website Settings.
help.firefox: Click the microphone or lock icon in the address bar, remove the “Blocked” permission, then run the test again.
help.android: Tap the lock icon beside the address → Permissions → Microphone → Allow, then reload the page.
help.noBypass: If access stays blocked, you can still use text chat inside the meeting, or the guided requirement form.
